description: One representative deleted set per Aut(HS)-orbit for every connected induced subgraph HS - S of order 38..49 that is not certified Phi < 0 by an integer vector; strict = D + delta* I positive definite (Bareiss). The single non-strict record (order 43) has Phi = 0. Labels P_(i,j), Q_(k,l) are the paper's coordinates; graph6 uses the surviving vertices in increasing HS index order.
